recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast collage blending Victorian-era industrial steam machinery in the foreground with a smooth, airbrushed celestial space scene in the background, characterized by a distinct teal, red, and monochromatic silver color scheme.
coreVisualRelationships: Juxtaposition of heavy, intricate mechanical gears against smooth, ethereal planetary spheres.
Contrast between the grainy, high-contrast black and white machinery and the soft gradients of the space background.
Geometric framing using solid red horizontal bars to anchor the composition top and bottom.
coreInvariants: Large blue-toned planet with orbital rings
Red rectangular blocks for text placement

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale industrial wheel dominates the lower right foreground; a massive planet occupies the upper right background.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large mechanical flywheel in the lower center-right acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the bold vertical text in the top left, follows the orbital rings across the planet, and descends into the complex machinery at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The teal sky provides breathing room in the upper left quadrant.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted red (horizontal bars and secondary text blocks)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the machinery; medium saturation in the teal and red elements.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme vertical elongation for primary display text
Wide letter spacing (tracking) for secondary header text
Clean, modern sans-serif for technical metadata
characterSpecificRedesigns: Primary display letters are compressed horizontally to create a tall, pillar-like effect.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast vertical display paired with wide-tracked horizontal slab serifs.

preserve: Vertical compression of the main title
Wide tracking of the secondary title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the ultra-condensed high-contrast serif display style.
Matches the sturdy slab serif used in the secondary header.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a surreal collage with a teal sky. In the foreground, place high-contrast black and white industrial steam engine parts, gears, and wheels. In the background, place a large blue planet with thin orbital rings and smaller floating spheres. Include a red horizontal bar at the top right and a red rectangle at the bottom right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply ultra-condensed white serif text in a black box at the top left. Apply wide-tracked white slab-serif text across the top red bar. Add lowercase serif text in the bottom red rectangle.

verificationChecks: Is the sky a consistent teal-green gradient?
Are the red bars solid and opaque?
Is the primary text vertically elongated?

adjustableVariables: Width of the red graphic bars
mustRedesign: Do not use exact artist signatures
Replace specific technical logos with generic geometric icons

mustAchieve: Grainy texture in the mechanical parts
Smooth airbrushed look in the space elements
Strict adherence to the teal/red/silver palette
avoid: Clean vector lines in the machinery

postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast halftone texture in the foreground.
Ensure the planet has a soft, diffused glow.
Verify the typography is perfectly aligned within the red bars.
Confirm the teal background feels like a flat color field with slight airbrushing.
Ensure the composition feels like a physical cut-and-paste collage.
recipe.reuseFormula: Industrial Monochrome + Airbrushed Celestial + Teal/Red Accents + Condensed Serif Typography
